title: Will and Autopsy
author: A. M. Pemberton
blurb: Marguerite Pemberton, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
